name: 存储 / 已挂载共享目录 / 试挂、创建、扫描、只读切换与删除保留文件
scope: Single targeted contract; not a full storage-type or page completion claim
identity: admin browser; real agent; the fixture process owns a private bind mount
fixture: isolated server, fresh SQLite, unique runId, real Chrome, real agent over WS, private bind mount standing in for an already-mounted shared directory, passwordless sudo required only for mount/umount

execution_evidence.reason: The agent probed the real bind mount (ok/readable/writable/capacity), reported the storage ready, and scanned the real directory into a model candidate. Deleting the storage left the mount and its files in place.

crud.create: covered: type/name/path/scope through the modal, real trial mount, create request body and 201 response
crud.read: covered: detail heading, independent GET with all node states, scan candidates
crud.update: covered: enabled true→false→true through the switch with exact boolean bodies and GET readback
crud.delete: covered: menu confirmation, DELETE 204, 404, list row gone, mount and files retained

fields.contract: switching the type shows only the fields of that type
covered: local default is replaced by shared_dir
shared_dir shows the shared path help and hides the NFS export field
missing: every other type in the same run
switching back and stale hidden values
empty/whitespace, uppercase, length boundaries and duplicate names

fields.contract: absolute path of an already-mounted directory
covered: real mount path round-trips in probe, create and independent GET
agent confirms the path is a mount point and writable
missing: empty/relative/invalid path errors
a directory that is not a mount point (probe refusal)
read-only mount saved as disabled

fields.contract: one by one requires at least one chosen node
covered: one chosen node by readable name
the same node in probe_node and targets
independent GET returns the node relation and its ready state
missing: labels scope
all nodes
rebinding A→B and clearing the selection
offline or deleted candidate rejection
the write-refusal path that keeps a storage read-only
runtime effect of a disabled storage on a real download

covered: confirmation names the storage and states that shared files stay
files and the mount survive deletion
missing: reference-protected deletion while a deployment uses the storage
delete failure and retry
Real CephFS/Lustre/NFS backing, its latency and disconnect behavior
Storage edit: name, path, targets, node overrides and expected_updated_at conflicts
Model import from scan candidates and a real download into the storage
Read-only enforcement: a disabled storage refusing writes/downloads
Reference-protected deletion while a deployment uses the storage
Local and NFS/NFS-cache type flows in the same lane
Pagination and large directory scans
The other locale (each run covers one --locale)
